name: animal-sounds
description: Classifies a short audio clip into 4 animal sound classes. YAMNet produces a 1024-value embedding per 0.48 s frame; the frames are averaged and a small dense network trained by the team predicts the class.

backbone.name: YAMNet
backbone.use: Frame embeddings averaged over the clip; YAMNet itself is not retrained.

training.data: audio_datasets/Animal Sound — Cats, Dogs, Frogs, Rooster subfolders
